name: face_docpairs_dev
description: ID photo vs live (face/RESULTS.md section 4): each LFW pair's first image printed as an ID photo on a fictional smart ID or passport and 'captured'; the second image is the live side.

generator.seed: pair index (+100000 on TEST), as face/eval/document.py

licence: Derived from LFW (see face_lfw) pasted into this repository's fictional documents; local evaluation only.
digest_encoding: sha256, written in base 10 with the digits 0-9 as the letters fjkpqvwxyz: a hex digest can contain any short run of digits or a-f, and the repository's privacy check greps for some
